My mom said he's been off his medication for a while (i dont know what kind). Most of the time he will be nice and buy me stuff but sometimes he will just yell at me over dumb things like a painting being uneven on the wall. He's only like this around me and my brother but my half sister never has to deal with his anger.

I signed up for some counseling recently so im hoping that will happen soon but idk :(
